project.title: 김씨 생존기: 무인도
project.oneLinePitch: 무인도에 조난된 김씨가 내용물을 알 수 없는 수색 오브젝트를 직접 뒤져 필요한 물건만 가방에 챙기고, 상태가 영구히 변하는 일곱 지역과 다층 캠프를 오가며 여러 방법으로 탈출하거나 행동 기반 코믹 엔딩을 맞는 2D 생존 게임.

stableIdRules.regionId: Preserve the seven existing region.* IDs exactly.
stableIdRules.rngIsolation: General loot, hazards and protected parts use isolated streams; resolving one node never advances another node's RNG.
stableIdRules.revisionRule: A run stores contractRevision and lootTableRevision. Loading uses the stored revisions; only a new run uses newer revisions.
stableIdRules.generationAuditRule: At new-run generation only, reroll unrevealed protected-part assignments until the minimum route audit passes; never reroll general loot or any player-known node.

finiteResourceTotals.countingRule: Counts general resource units only. Protected parts use project inventory and are excluded.

hazardSemantics.profileMappingRule: hazard-profile.* IDs are regional presentations mapped to the existing hazard.insects, hazard.wildlife, hazard.dangerous-plants, hazard.disease, hazard.injury or hazard.disaster families; they do not add new global hazard families.
hazardSemantics.telegraphRule: The region card and world clue name the category before exposure; no untelegraphed terminal result.
hazardSemantics.persistentRemovalRule: Only declared persistentRemovableHazardIds can become removed. Weather, roaming wildlife and disease exposure remain transient and may recur within the daily hazard budget.
hazardSemantics.removalAtomicity: A successful remove transaction commits hazardState=removed once; cancel, failure and input-device change preserve the previous state and cannot duplicate rewards or costs.

searchCostBands.applicationRule: Apply exactly once when the search completion transaction commits, never while the loot tray is open.

nodeStateContract.hiddenRule: Before the first completed search, show node name, archetype, search availability and perceived hazard clue only; never show exact item IDs, quantities or protected-part identity.
nodeStateContract.revealRule: The first completed search fixes and reveals the node's exact stacks once. The reveal and search cost commit before selection; closing the tray leaves all general loot in the node.
nodeStateContract.partialRule: After any take or swap, persist exact known remaining item names and quantities. Revisit shows known remaining summary without rerolling.
nodeStateContract.depletedRule: When no general stack and no pending protected part remains, persist depleted and return no reward on revisit.
nodeStateContract.sceneTransitionRule: Persist every completed search, take, swap, barrier break and hazard removal before return, forced return or scene unload.
nodeStateContract.newRunRule: A new run creates new snapshots from its run seed and never imports node, barrier or hazard state from another run.

lootSelectionContract.protectedPartRule: A protected part moves directly to protected project inventory on confirmed acquisition, shows a receipt, occupies no normal bag slot and cannot be discarded, stolen or overwritten.
lootSelectionContract.takeRule: Move the selected quantity node-to-bag atomically; a capacity or stack failure changes neither side.
lootSelectionContract.swapRule: Move one selected bag stack to the node and the selected node stack to the bag in one transaction; rollback both on failure.
lootSelectionContract.leaveRule: Leaving or closing preserves remainingStacks exactly and marks them known.
lootSelectionContract.cancelBeforeCompletion: No search cost, reveal, hazard roll or content commit.
lootSelectionContract.cancelAfterCompletion: Search cost and revealed contents remain committed once; no general loot moves unless a take or swap transaction already succeeded.

protectedPartContract.eligibleSearchRule: Count only a completed search in the missing part's listed primary or alternative region and an archetype whose eligiblePartIds contains that part. Cancelled, failed, unrelated, duplicate-producing and already-owned searches do not count.
protectedPartContract.guaranteeRule: After five eligible misses, insert the missing part before optional general loot in the next eligible uncommitted result. Never overwrite known loot or a different protected part.
protectedPartContract.radioDistinctRegionRule: part.radio.transceiver, part.radio.circuit-board and part.radio.transistor must resolve to three pairwise-distinct regions, including when alternatives or pity are used.

parts.completionNote: Protected compatibility component; it is not an extra smoke completion gate unless a separate recipe declares it.

protectedPartContract.auditRule: At every checkpoint, calculate reachable finite stock, completed milestones, refundable declared facilities, unopened eligible nodes and repair paths. PASS requires at least three completable escape methods and never all five blocked.
protectedPartContract.repairRule: A declared part-damage event may mark a part repairable but cannot delete it. Generic theft, camp damage, discard and bag replacement cannot target protected parts.

coreLoopFiveToTenMinutes.bagPressureRule: The first two nodes expose at least five distinct general-resource stacks across a maximum of eight carried units so a four-slot bag forces take, leave or swap without hiding the choice.
coreLoopFiveToTenMinutes.unlockRule: At least two start regions and one node in each are immediately eligible; exact loot remains hidden until search.

representativeEscapeTwentyFiveToThirtyFi.budgetSafety: The chosen seed must still leave one survival/recovery choice and at least two other completable escape methods after the representative smoke budget commits.

longStayCompatibility.finiteNodeRule: Expedition node contents never respawn in a run; long-stay eligibility never requires exhausting every node.
longStayCompatibility.maintenanceSeparationRule: Rain collection and already-defined farming or hunting/trapping maintenance outputs are outside finite expedition node stock and use their own tunable profile; this contract does not promise a new production feature or fix its final yield.
longStayCompatibility.survivalAuditRule: Before accepting a seed, current start stock plus reachable finite food/medicine plus enabled maintenance outputs must cover the selected long-stay profile's survival and recovery formula through its decision day.
longStayCompatibility.endingRule: Choosing not to escape and preserving finite nodes must remain valid; softlock repair may relocate only unrevealed protected parts and never regenerate known or depleted general loot.
longStayCompatibility.profileBoundary: Gamejam provisional long-stay timing and the canonical Day 50 campaign remain separate data profiles.

ui.search-node.prompt.qps-long: ⟦{inputGlyph} Şëårçh thrøügh {nodeName} før üsëfül şüpply ïtëmş⟧

localizationContract.tokenRule: Use named tokens and locale-owned word order. Never concatenate glyph, node name, action, quantities or status fragments in code.
localizationContract.idRule: Stable IDs and save fields are locale-independent ASCII and are never translated.

acceptanceMatrix.acceptance: Exactly seven existing region IDs, 21 archetype IDs and 42 instance IDs load; all regional finite totals sum to 144.
Same run seed and revisions produce byte-equal placements and contents; changing only the run seed changes at least one node without changing IDs.
Searching, cancelling or resolving one node does not advance any other node's loot stream.
Before first completed search, exact loot, quantity and part identity are absent; after commit they are exact and stable.
Take, leave and four-slot/six-slot stack-two swap conserve every item and rollback both sides on rejection.
Hidden, partial, depleted, broken barrier and removed persistent hazard states survive return, forced return and revisit in the same run; a new run resets them.
Each region exposes its declared category combination; telegraph precedes exposure and only declared persistent hazards stay removed.
Eight protected part IDs use declared eligible archetypes; radio's three parts resolve to three distinct regions and no bag, theft or generic damage action deletes them.
Only eligible completed misses count; miss 3 reveals a hint and after miss 5 the next eligible uncommitted result guarantees the part without overwriting known loot.
Generation, unlock, part change, Day 35 and Day 49 audits leave at least three completable escape methods and never block all five.
Without grant, warp or a solution hint, a first user completes two searches, one selection, one return and one investment in 5-10 minutes.
A valid natural representative run reaches smoke escape in 25-35 minutes while one survival choice and two other routes remain.
Finite node exhaustion cannot invalidate the selected long-stay ending profile when its declared maintenance systems and survival formula pass.
KO and EN carry equal state, quantities and failure reasons; qps-long clips no required action; future locales can reorder named tokens without save changes.
Keyboard/mouse and physical gamepad produce equal selection and transaction results; physical-device result remains UNVERIFIED until executed separately.

tasks.title: 게임잼 7지역 수색 node·유한 자원 계약
tasks.description: 기존 7지역과 5탈출 안정 ID를 보존하면서 21 archetype·42 node, 유한 자원 총량, 지역 위험 조합, 재방문 snapshot, 보호 핵심 부품과 3/5 pity·최소 3경로 seed 감사를 구현 가능한 정본으로 고정한다.
acceptanceCriteria: 미확인·부분 잔류·고갈·부순 장벽·제거 위험과 발견물 선별 transaction이 stable ID·snapshot 필드로 정의된다.
돛천·부싯돌·무전 3부품·조명탄·generator coil의 분산, eligible-search 3/5 pity와 seed당 최소 3탈출 경로 감사가 정의된다.
5~10분·25~35분 수치와 모든 node 총량은 BALANCE_PROVISIONAL이며 인간 자연 플레이테스트 전 final로 승격되지 않는다.
KO 정본·EN·qps-long·향후 언어 토큰과 구현/QA acceptance matrix가 안정 키로 존재한다.

decisions.decision: 기존 7지역 안정 ID 아래 지역당 3 archetype·archetype당 2 instance, 총 21 archetype·42 유한 node를 BALANCE_PROVISIONAL 게임잼 표본으로 사용한다.
첫 완료 수색 전에는 정확한 발견물을 숨기고, 완료 뒤 take·leave·swap을 원자 처리하며 알려진 잔여물과 고갈을 같은 node ID에 보존한다.
node 내용물은 run seed·region ID·node instance ID·revision의 격리 RNG로 한 번 결정하며 부분 잔류·부순 장벽·제거 위험을 같은 run 재방문에 복원한다.
보호 핵심 부품은 primary·alternative 적격 node에 분산하고 eligible miss 3 hint/5 guarantee와 seed당 최소 3탈출 경로 감사를 적용하며 알려진 일반 loot는 재배치하지 않는다.
node 수·자원 총량·수색 비용·30분 경로 예산은 인간 자연 플레이테스트 전 BALANCE_PROVISIONAL이며 한 축 증거 없이 final로 승격하지 않는다.
